BrochureContent.Content:
A Rare Coastal Retreat in the Heart of Connemara

Wake each morning to the sound of the Atlantic and enjoy a short stroll to the white sands of beautiful Culfin Beach (tra beag). Set on approximately 1.74 acres in one of the most spectacular locations along Ireland`s Wild Atlantic Way, Tra Beag Cottage presents a rare opportunity to acquire a spacious family home surrounded by some of Connemara`s finest scenery.

Nestled between the magnificent beaches of Culfin, Lettergesh and Glassilaun, and commanding breathtaking views of Maoil Reidh, Ireland`s third largest mountain, with Ben Coona to your right, this charming four-bedroom detached residence combines privacy, tranquillity and natural beauty with convenient access to Letterfrack, Kylemore Abbey, Connemara National Park and Clifden.

Whether you are seeking an exceptional holiday retreat, a permanent family home, a tranquil place to retire to or an investment in one of Ireland`s most desirable coastal location close to ATU furniture college this property offers outstanding living or rental potential.

The accommodation extends to approximately 143 sq m and comprises of generous living spaces, four bedrooms with the option of a fifth, a large kitchen and dining area, a utility room and mature gardens. Dimensions: Approx. 143 sq m (1,539 sq ft). The substantial site also includes an outbuilding, offering further potential subject to planning permission.

Properties within walking distance of an unspoilt sandy beach in this part of Connemara rarely come to market. This is an opportunity to enjoy an exceptional coastal lifestyle, where beaches, mountains and spectacular sunsets form part of everyday life.

Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the unique setting and considerable potential of this property.
